pages.quiz:
BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   B. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   D. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.
   C. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.
   D. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.
   C. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.
   D. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.
   C. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

8. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.

9. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.
   B. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.
   D. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.
   B. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.
   D. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   B. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.

12. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Income Statement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Statement of Financial Position and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Cash Flow Statement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. C — Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Statement of Financial Position; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Cash Flow Statement; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
